title: Pharmaceutical Strategies for Translating Klotho-Based Therapeutics: From Biologic Developability to Advanced Delivery Systems.
snippet: Klotho is a longevity-associated and tissue-protective protein involved in mineral metabolism, oxidative stress, inflammation, fibrosis, cellular senescence, and neurovascular homeostasis. However, nearly three decades after its discovery, no Klotho-based therapy has been approved, highlighting a translational gap that extends beyond biological validation.....
importanceSignals: priority topic: gene therapy, translational medicine
